proves: One canonical closed-tool runtime is byte-exact across the fork corpus, product template, authenticated managed-file artifact and npm package, while the authority-side root remains a single static re-export.
The published-template mirror mapping and npm archive required-entry check are bound to executed Harness owners rather than inferred from source presence.
doesNotProve: A local byte-exact projection proves neither that an external published-template repository has accepted the mirror nor that an npm registry release is active.

claims.text: The template, local checkout, hosted setup documentation and devcontainer use setup:all as one closed entrypoint for role governance plus repository-provisioned peer CLIs.
Installed governance runs from an exact lockfile-bound npm runtime instead of an ambient package copy.
Claude Code and Codex peer CLIs are materialized atomically from one complete SRI-bound transitive lock and reject unsupported Linux libc, poisoned shims and version drift.

Provider CLI package-content updates are derived by a deterministic proposal-only flow that downloads the shared resolver's active closure sequentially, delegates authority/lock/plan validation plus SRI and strict tar parsing to the installation SSOT, binds direct derivation-source hashes and the exact input-to-proposed manifest transition, supports independent zero-write pre/post-state verification that refetches and rederives every exact artifact, and has no direct apply mode.
Static product-template scaffold bytes are closed by the published scaffold lock.
A specific cloud vendor image, secret provisioner or provider CLI is externally certified.
An npm or GitHub release exists until immutable external readback succeeds.
Ordinary consumer upgrade is transactional and validates authenticated governance evidence.

The protected-base writer statically materializes the exact content-authorized provider CLI runtime in its disposable candidate without executing provider bytes, re-verifies the copied candidate and live replacement with the already-loaded protected-base verifier, reports certification separately, and rolls back the complete node_modules predecessor on failure or interruption.
Bootstrap, plan and readback paths fail closed when protected-base provenance is absent or forged.
Pathname-visible concurrent edits are revalidated at publication and recovery boundaries and fail closed instead of being silently overwritten.

The beta.84 package-shipped codemod changes only TypeScript AST bindings proven to originate from the design-system API, binds its exact parser and source inventory, is idempotent, and rejects ambiguity, dynamic field modes, DataTable meta.disabled, stale modes, links, lock contention, and partial publication.
A real consumer repository has merged the reviewed upgrade PR.
GitHub required checks or App identities are externally active.
Zero-data-loss against an arbitrary non-cooperative writer that retains an old open file descriptor and writes after pathname replacement.
